implementation_search_results.conclusion: This is a Prysm (Ethereum Consensus Client) repository. EIP-2200 storage gas mechanics are implemented in the Ethereum Execution Layer (EL), not the Consensus Layer (CL). Prysm does not contain EVM state management code.

TB-1.name: Outer Transaction Boundary
TB-1.protection_requirement: MUST be immutable after transaction begins

TB-2.name: Intermediate Call Boundary
TB-2.protection_requirement: MAY be modified by nested execution, MUST NOT affect _snapshots[0]

TB-3.name: Current Execution Context
TB-3.description: Current storage state actively being modified
TB-3.protection_requirement: MUST NOT be used as source for original values

key_properties: ∀ addr, key, depth: get_storage_original(addr, key) at depth d returns same value as at depth 0
∀ tx: _snapshots[0] before tx execution == _snapshots[0] after tx execution

invariants: INV-3: ∀ addr, key, depth: get_storage_original(addr, key) = _snapshots[0][addr][key]
